headline_seed: UAE trade embargo could shut Iran’s key economic escape route: Here’s why - Al Jazeera
draft_text:
#BreakingMews: Al Jazeera English reports the UAE has imposed an indefinite trade embargo on Iran, citing alleged ballistic missile attacks on UAE territory. Iran denies the attacks, calling them a false flag.

Reported by Al Jazeera English; also covered by The Washington Post.
